metadata.description: Comprehensive Islamic dua collection for NoorAI knowledge base
metadata.note: Arabic text, transliterations, and translations compiled from authenticated Islamic sources. All hadith gradings reflect scholarly consensus.

duas.title: Dua upon waking from sleep
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.when_to_recite: Immediately upon waking from sleep

duas.title: Dua upon waking — extended
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaikan-nushur
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
duas.when_to_recite: In the morning upon waking

duas.title: Dua before entering the bathroom
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all evil and evil-doers (male and female devils).
duas.when_to_recite: Before entering the toilet or bathroom

duas.title: Dua after leaving the bathroom
duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.transliteration: Ghufranaka
duas.translation: I seek Your forgiveness.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon exiting the toilet or bathroom

duas.title: Dua before performing wudu
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: Before beginning wudu (ablution)

duas.title: Dua after completing wudu
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Ash-hadu alla ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh. Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin
duas.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. O Allah, make me of those who return to You in repentance, and make me of those who are purified.
duas.when_to_recite: After completing wudu

duas.title: Dua when entering the mosque
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik
duas.translation: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon entering a mosque

duas.title: Dua when leaving the mosque
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon exiting a mosque

duas.title: Dua after hearing the adhan
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihi-d-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and superiority, and raise him to the praised station which You have promised him.
duas.when_to_recite: After the adhan is completed

duas.title: Morning remembrance — Sayyid al-Istighfar
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana abduk, wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi, faghfir li fa'innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. None has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am keeping my covenant with You and my promise to You as best I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sins, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
duas.when_to_recite: In the morning — if recited with certainty and one dies that day, they are among the people of Paradise

duas.title: Morning and evening remembrance — mastery of the day
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.translation: We have entered the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.when_to_recite: In the morning (substitute 'Amsayna' for 'Asbahna' in the evening)

duas.title: Morning and evening — seeking Allah's wellbeing
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for wellbeing in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening

duas.title: Morning and evening — seeking refuge from evil
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ash-hadu alla ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkihi
duas.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil and snares of the devil.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening

duas.title: Morning and evening — seeking sufficiency in Allah
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-alim
duas.translation: In the name of Allah with Whose name nothing can cause harm on earth or in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening, three times each — whoever recites this will not be afflicted by sudden calamity

duas.title: Morning and evening — contentment with Allah
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Raditu billahi rabba, wa bil-Islami dinan, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallama nabiyya
duas.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening, three times — Allah will be pleased with the one who says this

duas.title: Morning — life and death upon Islam
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn
duas.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, in Your mercy I seek relief. Rectify all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning

duas.title: Morning — affirmation of tawhid
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna ala fitratil-Islam, wa ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa ala dini nabiyyina Muhammad, wa ala millati abina Ibrahim, hanifan Musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin
duas.translation: We have entered upon the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, and the way of our father Ibrahim, who was a Muslim of true faith and was not of those who associate partners with Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning (substitute 'Amsayna' in the evening)

duas.title: Dua for anxiety and sorrow
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي وَنُورَ صَدْرِي وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni abduka, ibnu abdika, ibnu amatika, nasiyati biyadika, madin fiyya hukmuka, adlun fiyya qada'uka. As'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fi kitabika, aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqika, awis-ta'tharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaybi indak, an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi
duas.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your female servant. My forelock is in Your Hand. Your command over me prevails, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that belongs to You, with which You have named Yourself, or which You revealed in Your Book, or which You taught any of Your creation, or which You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You — that You make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness and the reliever of my distress.
duas.when_to_recite: When feeling anxious, sad, or distressed

duas.title: Short dua for anxiety and grief
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.
duas.when_to_recite: When feeling anxious, sad, weak, or in debt

duas.title: Dua when in distress
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-azimul-halim, la ilaha illallahu rabbul-arshil-azim, la ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-arshil-karim
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.when_to_recite: When struck by a great calamity or hardship

duas.title: Dua of Prophet Yunus (from the whale)
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanak, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
duas.translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory be to You! Verily, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.when_to_recite: When in extreme distress — no Muslim recites this except that Allah relieves their distress

duas.title: Dua for riding a mount or vehicle
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, alhamdu lillah. Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin. Wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha, watwi anna bu'dah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in this journey, and for deeds which please You. O Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover its distance quickly.
duas.when_to_recite: When beginning a journey or boarding a vehicle

duas.title: Dua upon returning from a journey
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.transliteration: Ayibuna ta'ibuna abiduna lirabbina hamidun
duas.translation: We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.
duas.when_to_recite: When returning from travel

duas.title: Dua before eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: Before eating — if one forgets, say 'Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah' (In the name of Allah at its beginning and end)

duas.title: Dua after eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah Who has given me this food and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.when_to_recite: After finishing a meal — past sins will be forgiven

duas.title: Dua when entering the home
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayral-mawlaji wa khayral-makhraj, bismillahi walajana wa bismillahi kharajna, wa alallahi rabbina tawakkalna
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of the entry and the good of the exit. In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon entering the home

duas.title: Dua when leaving the home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi, tawakkaltu alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon leaving the home

duas.title: Dua before sleeping
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.when_to_recite: Before sleeping

duas.title: Dua of the Prophet before sleeping
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini adhabaka yawma tab'athu ibadak
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
duas.when_to_recite: Before sleeping (three times)

duas.title: Dua of complete trust before sleeping
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk. La malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa binabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt
duas.translation: O Allah, I submit my soul to You, and I entrust my affair to You, and I turn my face to You, and I rely on You out of desire and fear of You. There is no refuge and no salvation from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed, and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.
duas.when_to_recite: Before sleeping — the last words before sleeping, whoever dies that night dies upon fitrah

duas.title: Dua when having a nightmare
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa iqabihi, wa sharri ibadihi, wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdhurun
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His servants, from the whispers of the devils, and from their presence.
duas.when_to_recite: When waking from a bad dream

duas.title: Dua when feeling angry
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.
duas.when_to_recite: When feeling angry

duas.title: Dua for paying off debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma akfini bihalaalika an haramika, wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwak
duas.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.
duas.when_to_recite: When in debt or financial difficulty

duas.title: Dua when visiting the sick
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba's, tahurun in sha'Allah
duas.translation: Do not worry, it will be a purification, if Allah wills.
duas.when_to_recite: When visiting a sick person

duas.title: Dua for healing the sick (ruqyah)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabban-nas, adhhibilba's, washfi, antash-shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove this harm and heal, You are the Healer, there is no healing but Your healing, a healing which leaves no illness behind.
duas.when_to_recite: When placing the hand on the sick person while reciting

duas.title: Dua when in pain — placing hand on affected area
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثاً) أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah (3x). A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir
duas.translation: In the name of Allah (three times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
duas.when_to_recite: When experiencing physical pain — place right hand on area of pain and recite seven times

duas.title: Dua upon hearing of someone's death
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَاخْلُفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma jurni fi musibati wakhluf li khayran minha
duas.translation: Truly, we belong to Allah, and truly to Him we shall return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon a calamity or upon hearing of someone's death

duas.title: Dua in the funeral prayer — for the deceased
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu wa afihi wa'fu anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi mudkhalahu, waghs-ilhu bilma'i wath-thalji wal-barad
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, and grant him wellbeing and pardon him. Honour the place where he is received, and make his entrance wide, and wash him with water, snow and hail.
duas.when_to_recite: During the funeral (janaza) prayer for the deceased

duas.title: Dua seeking forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min indika warhamni, innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim
duas.translation: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins but You. So grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me. Surely, You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking forgiveness for sins

duas.title: Dua when it rains
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
duas.translation: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.
duas.when_to_recite: When it begins to rain

duas.title: Dua upon hearing thunder
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatih
duas.translation: How perfect He is, the One whom the thunder glorifies with praise and so do the angels, out of awe of Him.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon hearing thunder

duas.title: Dua upon entering the marketplace
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon entering the marketplace

duas.title: Dua when admiring something (to prevent evil eye)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِيهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik fih
duas.translation: O Allah, bless it.
duas.source: Authenticated by Ibn al-Sunnah and verified by al-Albani
duas.when_to_recite: When you admire something so as to ward off the evil eye

duas.title: What to say when sneezing
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillah
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: When sneezing, say Alhamdulillah. The listener replies 'Yarhamukallah', and the sneezer then says 'Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum'

duas.title: Dua upon sighting the new crescent moon
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-islam. Rabbi wa rabbukallah
duas.translation: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon sighting the new crescent moon

duas.title: Dua for a newly married couple
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu laka wa baraka alayk, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr
duas.translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
duas.when_to_recite: When congratulating a newly married person

duas.title: Dua before marital relations
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillah. Allahumma jannibna ash-shaytana, wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us, and keep the devil away from what You bless us with.
duas.when_to_recite: Before marital relations — any child born will be protected from Satan

duas.title: Dua when feeling frightened at night
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa iqabihi, wa sharri ibadihi, wa min hamazatish-shayatini wa an yahdurun
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants and from the whispers of the devils and that they come near me.
duas.when_to_recite: When feeling fear or startled at night

duas.title: Dua when stopping at a rest place during travel
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.when_to_recite: When stopping at a resting place during travel — nothing will harm you until you leave that place

duas.title: Dua when wearing clothes
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha (ath-thawb) wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah Who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.when_to_recite: When putting on new clothes — past sins will be forgiven

duas.title: Rabbana — accept our deeds
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-sami'ul-alim
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.when_to_recite: When performing acts of worship, seeking acceptance of good deeds

duas.title: Rabbana — make us Muslims
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna Muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan Muslimatan lak, wa arina manasikana wa tub alayna, innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim
duas.translation: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
duas.when_to_recite: For oneself and children, seeking to die as Muslims and remain steadfast

duas.title: Rabbana — good in this world and the next
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhab an-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.when_to_recite: One of the most comprehensive duas — recite at any time for goodness in both worlds

duas.title: Rabbana — do not burden us beyond what we can bear
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil alayna isran kama hamaltahu alal-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih. Wa'fu anna, waghfir lana, warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna alal-qawmil-kafirin
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.when_to_recite: When feeling overwhelmed, facing hardship, or seeking forgiveness

duas.title: Rabbana — do not let our hearts deviate
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhab
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
duas.when_to_recite: For steadfastness of heart and protection from misguidance

duas.title: Rabbana — gather us on the Day of Judgment
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لاَّ رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللّهَ لاَ يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innaka jami'un-nasi li-yawmin la rayba fih, innallaha la yukhlifu al-mi'ad
duas.translation: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.
duas.when_to_recite: Reflecting on the Day of Judgment and seeking protection

duas.title: Rabbana — forgive our sins and remove our arrogance
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina adhab an-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking forgiveness and protection from Hell

duas.title: Rabbana — pour patience upon us and grant us victory
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna alal-qawmil-kafirin
duas.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking patience, firmness, and victory against adversity

duas.title: Rabbana — grant us righteous spouses and children
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.
duas.when_to_recite: For righteous family, spouses, and children

duas.title: Rabbana — forgive me and my parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa li-walidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking forgiveness for oneself, parents, and the believers

duas.title: Rabbana — mercy on my parents as they raised me
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them [my parents] as they raised me when I was small.
duas.when_to_recite: Dua for parents — especially when they are old or after their death

duas.title: Rabbana — make me and my children establish prayer
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, rabbana wa taqabbal du'a
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
duas.when_to_recite: For one's own prayer life and the piety of one's children

duas.title: Rabbana — do not make us a trial for the wrongdoers
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lil-ladhina kafaru, waghfir lana rabbana, innaka antal-azizul-hakim
duas.translation: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
duas.when_to_recite: When facing oppression, injustice, or persecution

duas.title: Rabbana — perfect our light for us
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atmim lana nurana waghfir lana, innaka ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking light (nur) on the Day of Judgment and forgiveness

duas.title: Rabbana — grant us provision and accept repentance
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a. Rabbana ighfir li wa li-walidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking acceptance of duas and forgiveness on the Day of Reckoning

duas.title: Rabbana — increase me in knowledge
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking knowledge, before studying, or during exams

duas.title: Rabbana — we have wronged ourselves
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa il-lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khassirin
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.source: Quran 7:23 — Dua of Adam and Hawwa
duas.when_to_recite: When repenting from sins — the dua of Prophet Adam (peace be upon him)

duas.title: Rabbana — let us not be among the disbelievers
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna ma'al-qawmidh-dhalimin
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking protection from being counted among the wrongdoers

duas.title: Rabbana — decide between us in truth
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana iftah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqqi wa anta khayr al-fatiheen
duas.translation: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking justice or truth to prevail

duas.title: Rabbana — be grateful to You and to parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakallati an'amta alayya wa ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah, wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimin
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking gratitude, righteous deeds, and righteousness for one's children

duas.title: Rabbana — I seek refuge from the whisperings of devils
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatini wa a'udhu bika rabbi an yahdurun
duas.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
duas.when_to_recite: When experiencing evil whispers, doubts, or waswas (obsessive thoughts)

duas.title: Rabbana — enter us into paradise
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana amanna faghfir lana warhamna wa anta khayrur-rahimin
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking forgiveness and mercy

duas.title: Rabbana — do not put us to trial with those who oppress
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lil-qawmidh-dhalimin, wa najjina birahmatika minal-qawmil-kafirin
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not make us [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking protection from oppressors and disbelievers

duas.title: Rabbana — make this a land of security and provide sustenance
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ij'al hadha baladan aminan warzuq ahlahu min ath-thamarat
duas.translation: My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking safety, security, and provision for one's community

duas.title: Rabbana — You are our Protector, so help us
duas.arabic: أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Anta waliyyuna faghfir lana warhamna wa anta khayrugh-ghafirin
duas.translation: You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking divine protection, forgiveness, and mercy

duas.title: Rabbana — accept our repentance
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-sami'ul-alim, wa tub alayna innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking acceptance of deeds and repentance

duas.title: Rabbana — remove envy from our hearts for believers
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-iman wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lil-ladhina amanu, rabbana innaka ra'ufur-rahim
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking forgiveness and purification of the heart from envy and hatred toward believers

duas.title: Rabbana — upon You we have relied and to You we return
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana alayka tawakkalna wa ilayka anabna wa ilayk al-masir
duas.translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
duas.when_to_recite: When placing trust in Allah and seeking His guidance in all matters

duas.title: Rabbana — grant us the gardens of paradise
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhlifu al-mi'ad
duas.translation: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking the fulfillment of Allah's promise of paradise

duas.title: Rabbana — remove from us punishment
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana akshif anna al-adhaba inna mu'minun
duas.translation: Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers.
duas.when_to_recite: When suffering hardship, calamity, or seeking relief

duas.title: Rabbana — make us submit to You and show us our rites
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka, wa arina manasikana
duas.translation: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking steadfastness in Islam and righteous descendants

duas.title: Dua of Prophet Ayyub — remove harm from me
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin
duas.translation: My Lord, indeed adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
duas.when_to_recite: When sick, afflicted, or in extreme difficulty — dua of Prophet Ayyub (Job)

duas.title: Dua of Prophet Ibrahim — seeking mercy
duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrur-waritheen
duas.translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors.
duas.when_to_recite: When feeling alone, or seeking children and family — dua of Prophet Zakariyya

duas.title: Rabbana — make us of those who offer prayer
duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-sami'ul-alim
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
duas.when_to_recite: After completing any act of worship or good deed

duas.title: Rabbana — we believe, so forgive us
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu birabbikum fa-amanna
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed.
duas.when_to_recite: Affirming faith and seeking Allah's acceptance

duas.title: Rabbana — do not make our hearts incline to wrong after guidance
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking steadfastness in faith

duas.title: Rabbana — grant us rizq and be grateful
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir
duas.translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
duas.when_to_recite: When in need or seeking provision — dua of Prophet Musa (Moses)

duas.title: Rabbana — grant me ease in my matter
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahlul uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli
duas.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest [with assurance] and ease for me my task. And untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech.
duas.when_to_recite: Before public speaking, teaching, giving dawah, or facing difficult tasks

duas.title: Dua of Prophet Nuh — seeking refuge in Allah
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni a'udhu bika an as'alaka ma laysa li bihi ilmun wa illa taghfir li wa tarhamni akun minal-khassirin
duas.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking refuge from ignorant requests and seeking forgiveness

duas.title: Dua of Prophet Yunus — from the belly of the whale
duas.arabic: لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanak, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
duas.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.when_to_recite: The most powerful dua for distress — no Muslim calls upon Allah with this except that Allah responds

duas.title: Salat al-Istikhara — dua for seeking guidance in a decision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi-ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min fadlikal-azim. Fa-innaka taqdiru wa la aqdiru wa ta'lamu wa la a'lamu wa anta allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fih. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa aqibati amri fasrifhu anni wasrifni anhu waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bih
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance [in making a choice] by virtue of Your knowledge, and I seek ability by virtue of Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty. You have power, I have none. And You know, I know not. You are the Knower of hidden things. O Allah, if in Your knowledge this matter is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and my affairs, then ordain it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. And if in Your knowledge this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and my affairs, then turn it away from me, and turn me away from it, and ordain for me the good wherever it may be, and make me pleased with it.
duas.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 7/162 — Narrated by Jabir ibn Abdullah
duas.when_to_recite: After 2 rak'at of salah (not fard), when facing a major decision. Say 'this matter' and think of your specific decision

duas.title: Istighfar — seeking forgiveness
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha al-azimal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilayh
duas.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent, besides Whom none has the right to be worshipped, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I repent to Him.
duas.when_to_recite: At any time — sins will be forgiven even if one has fled from battle

duas.title: Dhikr after salah — Subhanallah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (33) لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllah (33x), Alhamdu lillah (33x), Allahu Akbar (33x), La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah (33x). All praise is for Allah (33x). Allah is the greatest (33x). None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.when_to_recite: After every obligatory prayer

duas.title: Words most loved by Allah — four phrases
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illallah wa Allahu Akbar
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.
duas.when_to_recite: At any time — the Prophet said these words are more beloved to him than everything the sun rises upon

duas.title: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: There is no power nor strength except with Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: At any time — a treasure from the treasures of Paradise; recite when feeling helpless or overwhelmed

duas.title: Ayatul Kursi — the greatest verse
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma wa huwal-aliyyul-azim
duas.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.when_to_recite: After every obligatory prayer (leads to Paradise), before sleeping (protection all night), morning and evening

duas.title: Comprehensive dua — asking for all good
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi ajiluhi wa ajiluhi, ma alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi ajiluhi wa ajiluhi, ma alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. And I seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know.
duas.when_to_recite: A comprehensive dua suitable for any occasion

duas.title: Dua before reciting the Quran
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.
duas.when_to_recite: Before beginning to recite the Quran

duas.title: Dua for an absent Muslim
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu fik
duas.translation: May Allah bless you.
duas.source: Authenticated by al-Bukhari in Adab al-Mufrad
duas.when_to_recite: When wishing blessings for someone

duas.title: Dua before drinking water
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.source: at-Tirmidhi 4/257 — based on general bismillah before eating/drinking hadith
duas.when_to_recite: Before drinking water or any beverage

duas.title: Dua when drinking Zam Zam water
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an wa rizqan wasi'an wa shifa'an min kulli da'
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and cure from all diseases.
duas.when_to_recite: When drinking Zam Zam water

duas.title: Dua when waking up — praise and thanks
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi afani fi jasadi wa radda alayya ruhi wa adhina li bidhikrih
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah Who restored to me my health and returned my soul to me and has allowed me to remember Him.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon waking from sleep

duas.title: Dua when looking in the mirror
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta hassanta khalqi fa-hassin khuluqi
duas.translation: O Allah, just as You have made my external features beautiful, make my character beautiful as well.
duas.when_to_recite: When looking in the mirror

duas.title: Dua for knowledge and understanding
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا وَارْزُقْنِي فَهْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilman warzuqni fahma
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge and grant me understanding.
duas.source: Derived from Quran 20:114 — widely transmitted in Islamic tradition
duas.when_to_recite: Before and during studying, before exams

duas.title: Dua after completing something difficult
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi bini'matihi tatimmus-salihat
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah by Whose favour good works are completed.
duas.when_to_recite: When a good task or difficult matter is successfully completed

duas.title: Dua when something bad happens
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi ala kulli hal
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah in all circumstances.
duas.when_to_recite: In good and bad circumstances — maintaining gratitude

duas.title: Dua for breaking the fast (Iftar)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma laka sumtu wa ala rizqika aftart
duas.translation: O Allah, for You I have fasted and upon Your provision I break my fast.
duas.when_to_recite: When breaking the fast at iftar time

duas.title: Dua upon breaking fast — second narration
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Dhahaba az-zama', wabtallatil-uruq, wa thabatal-ajru insha'Allah
duas.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.
duas.when_to_recite: When breaking the fast at iftar

duas.title: Dua in sujood (prostration)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
duas.transliteration: Subhana rabbiyals-a'la
duas.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
duas.when_to_recite: During each prostration in salah (three times minimum)

duas.title: Dua in ruku (bowing)
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Subhana rabbiyal-azim
duas.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.
duas.when_to_recite: During ruku in salah (three times minimum)

duas.title: Dua al-Qunoot for Witr prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummah-dini fiman hadayt, wa afini fiman afayt, wa tawallani fiman tawallayt, wa barik li fima a'tayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt, innaka taqdi wa la yuqda alayk, wa innahu la yadhillu man walayt, tabarakta rabbana wa ta'alayt
duas.translation: O Allah, guide me among those whom You have guided, grant me wellbeing among those whom You have granted wellbeing, take me into Your charge among those You have taken into Your charge, and bless me in what You have given me, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For indeed You decree and none can decree against You, and none is humiliated whom You have taken as an ally. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted.
duas.when_to_recite: In the Witr prayer qunoot position, after ruku in the final rak'ah

duas.title: Dua for starting Tahajjud
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu, anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn. Wa lakal-hamdu anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn
duas.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise. You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them. And to You belongs all praise. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon rising for the night prayer (Tahajjud)

duas.title: What to say when hearing good news
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi bini'matihi tatimmus-salihat
duas.translation: Praise is for Allah by Whose grace good things are completed.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon receiving good news

duas.title: What to say when hearing bad news
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma ajirni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha
duas.translation: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon receiving distressing news or facing calamity

duas.title: Salat al-Hajah — prayer of need
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ لَا تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ وَلَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-Halimul-Karim. SubhanAllahi rabbil-arshil-azim. Alhamdu lillahi rabbil-alamin. As'aluka mujibati rahmatika, wa aza'ima maghfiratika, wal-ghanimata min kulli birrin, was-salamata min kulli ithmin, la tada'a li dhanban illa ghafartah, wa la hamman illa farrajtah, wa la hajatan hiya laka ridan illa qadaytaha ya Arhamar-rahimin
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. Glory is to Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. I ask You for that which incites Your mercy and that which will cause Your forgiveness to be assured, and a share of every righteous deed, and safety from every sin. Do not leave for me a sin without forgiving it, nor a worry without relieving it, nor a need pleasing to You without fulfilling it, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.
duas.when_to_recite: After 2 rak'at of nafl prayer when you have an important need

duas.title: Dua for protection of children — dua of Prophet Ibrahim
duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammatin wa min kulli aynin lammah
duas.translation: I seek refuge for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous reptile, and from every evil eye.
duas.when_to_recite: Recited over children for their protection — this is what Ibrahim used to seek refuge for Ismail and Ishaq

duas.title: Ruqyah for evil eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.when_to_recite: Seeking protection from evil in general, especially at night or in unfamiliar places

duas.title: Dua for love between spouses
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma allif bayna qulubina wa aslih dhata baynina wahhdina subulas-salam wa najjina minaz-zulumati ilan-nur
duas.translation: O Allah, unite our hearts, improve our relationships, guide us to ways of peace, and deliver us from darkness into light.
duas.when_to_recite: For unity and love between family members, spouses, or community

duas.title: Dua for protection from poverty and debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-faqri wal-qillati wadh-dhillati, wa a'udhu bika min an azlima aw uzlam
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity and humiliation, and I seek refuge in You from wronging others or being wronged.
duas.when_to_recite: When in financial difficulty or fearing poverty

duas.title: Dua for guidance on the straight path
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-afafa wal-ghina
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.
duas.when_to_recite: Daily — seeking guidance, righteousness, chastity, and independence from others

duas.title: Istiftah — opening dua in salah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika wa tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruk
duas.translation: How perfect You are, O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed is Your name and Exalted is Your majesty. None has the right to be worshipped but You.
duas.when_to_recite: After the opening takbir of salah, before Al-Fatiha

duas.title: At-Tashahhud — the testimony in prayer
duas.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.transliteration: At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat. As-salamu alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. As-salamu alayna wa ala ibadillahis-salihin. Ash-hadu alla ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh
duas.translation: All greetings, prayers and good words are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no deity but Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
duas.when_to_recite: In the sitting (qa'dah) position during salah

duas.title: Dua before tasleem — seeking protection from four things
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabri, wa min adhabi jahannam, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-Masihid-Dajjal
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hellfire, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah (Dajjal).
duas.when_to_recite: After tashahhud and salawat, before the final salam in salah

duas.title: Salawat Ibrahim — blessings upon the Prophet in salah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin kama barakta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid
duas.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory.
duas.when_to_recite: After the tashahhud in salah

duas.title: Sending abundant blessings on the Prophet (Friday)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad
duas.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad.
duas.when_to_recite: Abundantly on Fridays — the Prophet said to send 80 salawat to have 80 years of sins forgiven

duas.title: Dua for a good ending — kalimah at death
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallah
duas.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: The last words — the Prophet said: whoever's last words are 'La ilaha illallah' will enter Paradise

duas.title: Dua for a righteous spouse
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin, waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking a righteous spouse or praying for one's family

duas.title: Dua for health and wellbeing
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma afini fi badani, Allahumma afini fi sam'i, Allahumma afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant
duas.translation: O Allah, grant health to my body. O Allah, grant health to my hearing. O Allah, grant health to my sight. None has the right to be worshipped but You.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening, three times each

duas.title: Dua of need — Hasbunallah
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallah wa ni'mal-wakil
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best disposer of affairs.
duas.when_to_recite: When in a difficult situation or feeling overwhelmed — the words of Ibrahim when thrown into the fire

duas.title: Dua seeking light in all affairs
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ فِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ فِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al fi qalbi nuran, wa fi lisani nuran, waj'al fi sam'i nuran, waj'al fi basari nuran, waj'al min khalfi nuran, wa min amami nuran, waj'al min fawqi nuran, wa min tahti nuran
duas.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light behind me, light in front of me, light above me, and light below me.
duas.when_to_recite: When going to the masjid for Fajr prayer, or seeking light and clarity in one's affairs

duas.title: Dua for tawfiq — ability to do good
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik
duas.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give thanks to You, and to worship You well.
duas.when_to_recite: After every fard (obligatory) prayer — the Prophet commanded Mu'adh ibn Jabal to recite this

duas.title: Protection from tests in morning and evening
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in this world and the Hereafter.
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening

duas.title: Dua for sincerity and purifying intention
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lam, wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lam
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating partners with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.
duas.when_to_recite: Regularly, especially when concerned about sincerity in one's deeds

duas.title: Dua for blessed provision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fi ma razaqtana, wa qina adhaban-nar
duas.translation: O Allah, bless for us that which You have provided for us, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.source: Compiled from related narrations — widely practiced
duas.when_to_recite: Before or after meals and when receiving provision

duas.title: The Prophet's dua for his Ummah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ قَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihdi qawmi fa'innahum la ya'lamun
duas.translation: O Allah, guide my people, for they do not know.
duas.when_to_recite: When people wrong you out of ignorance — follow the Prophet's example of seeking their guidance rather than their punishment

duas.title: Dua in the last third of the night
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum birahmatika astaghith
duas.translation: O Ever-Living, O Eternal Sustainer, I seek help through Your mercy.
duas.when_to_recite: In the last third of the night when Allah descends and asks 'who is calling upon Me that I may answer?'

duas.title: Dua before starting any important matter
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
duas.source: Quran 1:1 — hadith: Abu Dawud — 'Every important matter not begun with Bismillah is cut off'
duas.when_to_recite: Before beginning any important action or matter

duas.title: When completing any act — Alhamdulillah
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillah
duas.translation: All praise and thanks are for Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: After completing any matter, eating, drinking, or receiving a blessing

duas.title: After relief from hardship
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr
duas.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You and all thanks are for You.
duas.source: Authenticated practice — based on multiple narrations
duas.when_to_recite: After being relieved of difficulty or hardship

duas.title: Dua when feeling duas are not accepted
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn
duas.translation: O Ever-Living, O Eternal Sustainer, I seek help through Your mercy. Set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
duas.when_to_recite: When feeling despair or that duas are not answered — trust that Allah always responds

duas.title: Dua when seeing someone in difficulty
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi afani mimma ibtalaaka bihi, wa faddalani ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah Who has saved me from that which He has afflicted you with, and Who has favoured me greatly above many of those whom He has created.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeing someone afflicted with illness or tribulation — said quietly, not in front of them

duas.title: Dua after obligatory prayers — seeking love of Allah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli, wa a'udhu bika min an uradda ila ardhalil-umuri, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatid-dunya
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being returned to the worst of ages (extreme old age), and I seek refuge in You from the trials of this world.
duas.when_to_recite: After obligatory prayers

duas.title: Light on the tongue, heavy on the scales
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-azim
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah and His is the praise, Glory be to Allah the Most Great.
duas.when_to_recite: Light on the tongue, heavy on the scales on the Day of Judgment, beloved to the Most Merciful

duas.title: Surah Al-Inshirah — reminder after hardship comes ease
duas.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
duas.transliteration: Fa inna ma'al-usri yusra, inna ma'al-usri yusra
duas.translation: For indeed, with hardship will be ease. Indeed, with hardship will be ease.
duas.when_to_recite: A verse of remembrance and hope to recite when in difficulty

duas.title: Dua for the Muslim Ummah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ اللَّهُمَّ فَرِّجْ عَنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْ أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslih ummata Muhammad. Allahumma farrij an ummati Muhammad. Allahumma irham ummata Muhammad
duas.translation: O Allah, rectify the condition of the Ummah of Muhammad. O Allah, relieve the Ummah of Muhammad of their hardships. O Allah, have mercy on the Ummah of Muhammad.
duas.source: Widely narrated practice of the Prophet ﷺ
duas.when_to_recite: When making dua for the Muslim community globally

duas.title: Muawwidhatain — Surahs Al-Falaq and An-Nas for protection
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq...
duas.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of that which He created...
duas.when_to_recite: Morning and evening three times, before sleeping, after each obligatory prayer — best protection against evil eye, magic, and jinn

duas.title: Comprehensive dua for parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa li-walidayya, rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents. My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was young.
duas.when_to_recite: After every prayer, especially for parents who have passed away

duas.title: Talbiyah — the call of Hajj and Umrah
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayk la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak
duas.translation: Here I am O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace, and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
duas.when_to_recite: From the point of entering ihram until stoning of the Jamarat on Eid al-Adha

duas.title: Dua during strong winds
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayriha wa khayra ma fiha wa khayra ma ursilat bih, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ursilat bih
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good within it, and the good it was sent with. And I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil within it, and the evil it was sent with.
duas.when_to_recite: When experiencing strong winds

duas.title: Dua upon first seeing the Kaabah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ فَحَيِّنَا رَبَّنَا بِالسَّلَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam, fa-hayyina rabbana bis-salam
duas.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Greet us, our Lord, with peace.
duas.when_to_recite: Upon first sighting the Kaabah

duas.title: Dua for Laylatul Qadr — Night of Power
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fa'fu anni
duas.translation: O Allah, You are pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
duas.when_to_recite: Specifically taught by the Prophet to Aisha for Laylatul Qadr — recite abundantly in the last 10 nights of Ramadan

duas.title: Dua of gratitude after a meal — extended
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
