duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fihi, ghayra makfiyyin wa la muwadda'in wa la mustaghnan anhu rabbana
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah, abundant praise, pure and blessed, indispensable, not abandoned, not dispensed with — praise be to our Lord.
duas.when_to_recite: After eating a meal

duas.title: Dua for patience and perseverance
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh alayna sabran wa tawaffana muslimin
duas.translation: Our Lord, pour out patience upon us and let us die as Muslims.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking patience and a good ending to life

duas.title: Dua for good character
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ صِحَّةً فِي إِيمَانٍ وَإِيمَانًا فِي حُسْنِ خُلُقٍ وَنَجَاحًا يَتْبَعُهُ فَلَاحٌ وَرَحْمَةً مِنْكَ وَعَافِيَةً وَمَغْفِرَةً مِنْكَ وَرِضْوَانًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka sihhatan fi iman, wa imanan fi husni khuluq, wa najahan yatba'uhu falah, wa rahmatan minka wa afiyatan wa maghfiratan minka wa ridwana
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for sound faith, faith expressed in good character, success followed by prosperity, mercy from You, wellbeing, forgiveness from You, and Your pleasure.
duas.when_to_recite: When seeking improvement in character, manners, and overall goodness

duas.title: Dua after obligatory prayers — comprehensive
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram
duas.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour.
duas.when_to_recite: Immediately after the tasleem of each obligatory prayer

duas.title: Kaffaratul Majlis — expiation of a gathering
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika ash-hadu alla ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
duas.when_to_recite: At the end of any gathering or sitting — expiates sins committed during the session

duas.title: Dua when eating at someone's home
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum
duas.translation: O Allah, bless for them what You have provided them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.
duas.when_to_recite: When invited to someone's home for a meal

duas.title: Dua seeking Paradise
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
duas.when_to_recite: At any time — the Prophet said whoever asks for Paradise three times, Paradise says 'O Allah, admit him', and whoever seeks refuge from Fire three times, the Fire says 'O Allah, protect him'

duas.title: Dua when visiting the graveyard
duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَلَاحِقُونَ نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.transliteration: As-salamu alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'minina wal-muslimin, wa inna insha'Allahu bikum la-lahiqun. Nas'alullaha lana wa lakumul-afiyah
duas.translation: Peace be upon you O inhabitants of the dwellings (graves), from among the believers and Muslims, and indeed we will, if Allah wills, be joining you. We ask Allah for wellbeing for us and for you.
duas.when_to_recite: When entering or passing by a cemetery

duas.title: Surah Al-Mulk — protection from punishment of the grave
duas.arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Tabaraka-lladhi biyadihil-mulku wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir...
duas.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent...
duas.when_to_recite: Recite Surah Al-Mulk every night before sleeping — it intercedes for its reciter and protects from the punishment of the grave

duas.title: Dua of desperation — Faraj after hardship
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn, wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu, la ilaha illa ant
duas.translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for; do not leave me to myself for even the blink of an eye. Set right all my affairs. There is none worthy of worship but You.
duas.when_to_recite: When in extreme hardship and feeling completely helpless

duas.title: What to say when you see something you dislike
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَأْتِ بِالْحَسَنَاتِ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَلَا يَدْفَعُ السَّيِّئَاتِ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la ta'ti bil-hasanati illa anta wa la yadfa'us-sayyi'ati illa anta wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: O Allah, none brings good except You and none repels evil except You, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.
duas.when_to_recite: When you see something you dislike

duas.title: Dua when experiencing doubts in faith
duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
duas.transliteration: Amantu billahi wa rusulihi
duas.translation: I believe in Allah and His messengers.
duas.when_to_recite: When experiencing doubts about faith or waswas (whispers) from Shaytan

duas.title: Best words of remembrance
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, with no partner or associate. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.when_to_recite: 100 times in the morning — equivalent to freeing 10 slaves, 100 good deeds recorded, 100 sins erased, protection from Shaytan for the day

duas.title: Dua for good in all matters — the Prophet's favourite
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li dini alladhi huwa ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyaya allati fiha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhirati allati fiha ma'adi, waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr
duas.translation: O Allah, reform for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs; reform for me my worldly life in which is my livelihood; reform for me my Hereafter to which is my return; and make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a rest for me from every evil.
duas.reference_number: Comprehensive dua for deen dunya akhira
duas.when_to_recite: One of the most comprehensive duas — recite daily covering religion, worldly life, and the Hereafter
